blind.description: A stylized fantasy-style great telescope mounted on a heavy wooden wheeled carriage. The telescope barrel is conical, finished in bright polished brass with dark iron reinforcement bands and rivets, ending in a dark glass objective lens at the wide front end and a narrow brass eyepiece at the rear. It is mounted via trunnions and a golden elevation gear arc onto an A-frame timber carriage supported by four small wooden wheels and reinforced with dark metal brackets.
blind.from_above: A vertically aligned, tapering golden brass cylinder with dark bands and a circular front lens opening at the top, resting centrally over a rectangular wooden carriage base with wheels protruding slightly at the sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 80% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 4.5 to 5 ft tall at the raised tip), with a base roughly 3 ft wide and 3 ft long.
